forward_workspace.transfer_scope: Logical workspace payload bytes, not measured PCIe transactions.

forward_memory.accounting_scope: Each field carries its own instrument and overlaps the others; the fields are never added into one total. Torch allocated is a subset of Torch reserved, both are a subset of the device memory of the process; pinned staging appears in the working set and the commit charge; host field banks appear in the working set and in the bank ledger; the OS file cache is system-wide. Caller graphs, optimizer state and the CUDA context are measured only where the process-level instruments include them.
forward_memory.total_memory_note: Not defined: the fields overlap and are never summed.

peak_torch_allocated_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after the phase (allocator peak counter; the phase set a new process peak, so it is exact)
peak_torch_allocated_bytes.caveat: Torch caching-allocator bytes handed to tensors on this device; a subset of the reserved bytes and of the device memory of the process; excludes the CUDA context, CuPy kernel modules and other processes

peak_torch_reserved_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved after the phase (allocator peak counter; the phase began at the process peak and stayed at or below it, so it is exact)
peak_torch_reserved_bytes.caveat: Torch caching-allocator bytes held from the driver, including cached blocks not handed to any tensor; contains the allocated bytes, so the two are not added

cuda_process_memory_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.mem_get_info free-memory decrease during the phase, sampled every 0.02 s and at the end (device-wide, from the driver)
cuda_process_memory_bytes.caveat: Device-wide: includes the Torch reserved bytes (so it is not added to them), the CUDA context, CuPy allocations and any other process on the same device; nvidia-smi per-process used_memory is reported separately when the driver exposes it (it does not under WDDM on Windows)
cuda_process_memory_bytes.nvidia_smi_instrument: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps reports N/A or is unavailable for this process

peak_process_rss_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, working set sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_rss_bytes.caveat: Host working set (RSS) of the whole process: interpreter, libraries, CUDA runtime host mappings, pinned staging, host field banks and caller tensors; host memory, not device memory; the OS lifetime peak is a process-wide high-water mark that may predate this phase

peak_process_private_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, private bytes sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_private_bytes.caveat: Private (non-shared) host bytes of the process; overlaps the working set and the commit charge

peak_process_committed_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, committed bytes sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_committed_bytes.caveat: Commit charge of the process (Windows PagefileUsage; virtual size on Linux): includes pinned staging and pageable allocations whether resident or not; overlaps the working set

os_file_cache_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetPerformanceInfo: SystemCache pages times PageSize, at the phase boundaries and sampled every 0.02 s
os_file_cache_bytes.caveat: System-wide file cache change during the phase: every process and file on the machine contributes, so it is not attributable to the scratch files alone and can be negative

scratch_disk_written_bytes.instrument: no scratch store in this phase (host banks)
scratch_disk_written_bytes.caveat: Logical bytes written to the scratch bank files; the OS may absorb them in its page cache, so they are not physical storage traffic; the process I/O counters cover every file handle of the process
scratch_disk_written_bytes.process_io_instrument: kernel32.GetProcessIoCounters: ReadTransferCount, WriteTransferCount (all handles, not only scratch files)

scratch_disk_read_bytes.instrument: no scratch store in this phase (host banks)
scratch_disk_read_bytes.caveat: Logical bytes read from the scratch bank files, warm-cache reads included; not physical storage traffic
scratch_disk_read_bytes.process_io_instrument: kernel32.GetProcessIoCounters: ReadTransferCount, WriteTransferCount (all handles, not only scratch files)

scratch_disk_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.instrument: logical scratch bytes divided by the phase wall time, which includes compute and transfers
scratch_disk_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.caveat: an effective rate over the whole phase, not a storage benchmark and not physical bandwidth

scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes.instrument: no scratch store in this phase (host banks)
scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes.caveat: Peak sum of live scratch bank file sizes (files are truncated to the bank size at creation)

host_bank_bytes.instrument: SlabBlockOperator bank ledger: bytes of live host field banks, released through weak references
host_bank_bytes.caveat: Host tensors that also appear in the working set and the commit charge; zero for disk banks, whose sizes are the scratch file bytes

host_bank_bytes.instrument: SlabBlockOperator bank ledger: bytes of live host field banks, released through weak references
host_bank_bytes.caveat: Host tensors that also appear in the working set and the commit charge; zero for disk banks, whose sizes are the scratch file bytes

forward_workspace.transfer_scope: Logical workspace payload bytes, not measured PCIe transactions.

forward_memory.accounting_scope: Each field carries its own instrument and overlaps the others; the fields are never added into one total. Torch allocated is a subset of Torch reserved, both are a subset of the device memory of the process; pinned staging appears in the working set and the commit charge; host field banks appear in the working set and in the bank ledger; the OS file cache is system-wide. Caller graphs, optimizer state and the CUDA context are measured only where the process-level instruments include them.
forward_memory.total_memory_note: Not defined: the fields overlap and are never summed.

peak_torch_allocated_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after the phase (allocator peak counter; the phase set a new process peak, so it is exact)
peak_torch_allocated_bytes.caveat: Torch caching-allocator bytes handed to tensors on this device; a subset of the reserved bytes and of the device memory of the process; excludes the CUDA context, CuPy kernel modules and other processes

peak_torch_reserved_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved after the phase (allocator peak counter; the phase began at the process peak and stayed at or below it, so it is exact)
peak_torch_reserved_bytes.caveat: Torch caching-allocator bytes held from the driver, including cached blocks not handed to any tensor; contains the allocated bytes, so the two are not added

cuda_process_memory_bytes.instrument: torch.cuda.mem_get_info free-memory decrease during the phase, sampled every 0.02 s and at the end (device-wide, from the driver)
cuda_process_memory_bytes.caveat: Device-wide: includes the Torch reserved bytes (so it is not added to them), the CUDA context, CuPy allocations and any other process on the same device; nvidia-smi per-process used_memory is reported separately when the driver exposes it (it does not under WDDM on Windows)
cuda_process_memory_bytes.nvidia_smi_instrument: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps reports N/A or is unavailable for this process

peak_process_rss_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, working set sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_rss_bytes.caveat: Host working set (RSS) of the whole process: interpreter, libraries, CUDA runtime host mappings, pinned staging, host field banks and caller tensors; host memory, not device memory; the OS lifetime peak is a process-wide high-water mark that may predate this phase

peak_process_private_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, private bytes sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_private_bytes.caveat: Private (non-shared) host bytes of the process; overlaps the working set and the commit charge

peak_process_committed_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo: WorkingSetSize, PeakWorkingSetSize, PrivateUsage, PagefileUsage, PeakPagefileUsage, committed bytes sampled every 0.02 s and at the phase boundaries
peak_process_committed_bytes.caveat: Commit charge of the process (Windows PagefileUsage; virtual size on Linux): includes pinned staging and pageable allocations whether resident or not; overlaps the working set

os_file_cache_bytes.instrument: psapi.GetPerformanceInfo: SystemCache pages times PageSize, at the phase boundaries and sampled every 0.02 s
os_file_cache_bytes.caveat: System-wide file cache change during the phase: every process and file on the machine contributes, so it is not attributable to the scratch files alone and can be negative

scratch_disk_written_bytes.instrument: no scratch store in this phase (host banks)
scratch_disk_written_bytes.caveat: Logical bytes written to the scratch bank files; the OS may absorb them in its page cache, so they are not physical storage traffic; the process I/O counters cover every file handle of the process
scratch_disk_written_bytes.process_io_instrument: kernel32.GetProcessIoCounters: ReadTransferCount, WriteTransferCount (all handles, not only scratch files)

scratch_disk_read_bytes.instrument: no scratch store in this phase (host banks)
scratch_disk_read_bytes.caveat: Logical bytes read from the scratch bank files, warm-cache reads included; not physical storage traffic
scratch_disk_read_bytes.process_io_instrument: kernel32.GetProcessIoCounters: ReadTransferCount, WriteTransferCount (all handles, not only scratch files)

scratch_disk_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.instrument: logical scratch bytes divided by the phase wall time, which includes compute and transfers
scratch_disk_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.caveat: an effective rate over the whole phase, not a storage benchmark and not physical bandwidth

scope:
Matched CPU, resident CUDA and DRAM-streamed CUDA forward/objective/VJPs.

The CPU reference is TorchFDTD's Torch backend, not an optimized external
CPU solver. This measures a fixed discrete workload, not optical convergence,
kernel-only throughput, beyond-VRAM capacity or a complete optimizer loop.
timing_scope: Fresh model construction, material scaling/packing, CPU-to-GPU inputs, forward, plane-field and signed-flux proxy objective, replay/backward and CPU outputs/material VJPs. Excludes input leaf allocation, project copy, GC, thread changes, verification, final cleanup and optimizer/geometry. One full-duration warm-up per mode, then interleaved repetitions. No cache flush between trials. CPU ratios use the fastest tested CPU-thread median, not the fastest possible CPU implementation.
memory_scope: 50 ms sampled whole-process RSS includes reference, runtime and allocator pools. Torch allocated/reserved peaks exclude CUDA context and non-Torch allocations. Native reservations plus benchmark allowances are engineering estimates, not RSS guarantees.

sweep_overrides.monitor_downsample: size//8 up to 256^3, 32 above (monitor model limit)
